key.name: skip-apps
key.description: Desktop file ids (for example org.gnome.Ptyxis.desktop) that are neither saved nor restored, for apps that another tool places.

key.name: launch-apps
key.description: After a login, start each saved app that has no window yet and is not running, once.

key.name: launch-delay
key.description: Gives autostart apps time to open their own windows first, so nothing is started twice.

key.name: restore-seconds
key.summary: How long new windows are matched
key.description: Seconds after a login (or a restore-now) during which new windows are put on their saved spots. Saving waits until this is over.

key.name: save-interval
key.description: The layout is written only when it changed. A layout with fewer windows is written only when it is the same on two saves in a row, so windows closing at logout do not overwrite the saved layout.

key.name: save-now
key.description: Set to true to save the layout at once (also during a restore); it goes back to false.

key.name: restore-now
key.description: Set to true to put the open windows back on their saved spots and start missing apps, as after a login; it goes back to false.
